content.title: Stanley Black & Decker Further Shaves Portfolio with Aerospace Component Sale
content.summary: Stanley Black & Decker is further slimming its product lines with a $1.8 billion deal to sell its aerospace component business to Howmet Aerospace.  The business makes latches, quick-release pins and tube assemblies for commercial jets and the defense industry, but it is secondary to Stanley’s bread-and-butter power tools and outdoor equipment businesses.  CEO Chris Nelson said the deal will reduce Stanley’s debt and allow it to focus on its largest brands.
